tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec123/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -I -B - <<'EOF'
import json,hashlib,pathlib
rep=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'))
a=rep['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts'];bad=[]
for p,s in a.items():
  f=pathlib.Path(p)
  if not f.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=s: bad.append(p)
print('n',len(a),'bad',bad)
cur=sorted(str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('system-spec').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
print('not in snapshot',[c for c in cur if c not in a])
print('audit verdicts',[(d['component'],d['verdict']) for d in rep['audit_delegations']])
EOF
ls eval-log/ eval-log/*/ | head -80; ls -la ../workdir/tool-observer/ 2>&1 | head
